{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)

# Get the channel with the highest revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]['channel']
total_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]['revenue']

# Print summary
total_revenue_by_channel, best_channel, total_revenue"}
